tasks.title: Use singular call wording in cost reports
tasks.instructions: Update cost report formatting so a task with exactly one request displays `1 call`, while all other counts continue displaying `N calls`. Add focused coverage to the existing cost tests.

hidden_checks.description: A one-request cost entry uses singular wording.
hidden_checks.command: node --import tsx -e "import {formatCostReport} from './src/worker/cost.ts'; const s={total_cost_usd:1,total_requests:1,by_task:{T1:{total_cost_usd:1,total_input_tokens:1,total_output_tokens:1,request_count:1}}}; const r=formatCostReport(s); if(!r.includes('1 call')||r.includes('1 calls')) process.exit(1)"

tasks.title: Preserve comment markers inside quoted YAML values
tasks.instructions: Correct `parseSimpleYaml` so `#` characters inside single- or double-quoted values are preserved, while trailing comments on unquoted values are still removed. Add tests for quoted values, unquoted inline comments, and ordinary values.

hidden_checks.description: Quoted hash characters survive parsing while real inline comments do not.
hidden_checks.command: node --import tsx -e "import {parseSimpleYaml} from './src/utils/config.ts'; const r=parseSimpleYaml('label: \"alpha # beta\"\nmode: fast # local'); if(r.label!=='alpha # beta'||r.mode!=='fast') process.exit(1)"

tasks.title: Restore the tmux Ctrl-C interrupt mapping
tasks.instructions: A regression maps the abstract `ctrlc` interrupt to Escape for tmux workers. Restore the correct `C-c` mapping and ensure the existing interrupt tests protect codex, gemini, unknown-agent, and cmux behavior.

hidden_checks.description: Configured Ctrl-C produces the correct adapter-specific keys.
All interrupt aliases and fallback sequences still pass.

tasks.title: Finish busy-screen detection for working workers
tasks.instructions: Resume an interrupted idle-detection change. Extend codex, gemini, and opencode busy hints to recognize terminal output containing `working`, so a visible shell-like prompt in progress text is not mistaken for an idle worker. Add a regression case to the existing worker messaging tests without changing Claude behavior.

hidden_checks.description: Working screens are busy for supported CLI agents, but ready prompts remain idle.
hidden_checks.command: node --import tsx -e "import {isWorkerIdleScreen} from './src/worker/idle.ts'; if(isWorkerIdleScreen('$ working on changes','codex')) process.exit(1); if(!isWorkerIdleScreen('$ ready','codex')) process.exit(1)"

hidden_checks.description: Message delivery still defers busy workers and handles urgent interruption.

tasks.title: Review and repair Authorization header redaction
tasks.instructions: Review the injected redaction change as a security defect. Restore redaction of `Authorization: Bearer ...` and `Authorization=Bearer ...` values while preserving the header prefix. Add focused tests covering both separators and ensuring surrounding text remains visible.

hidden_checks.description: Bearer credentials never remain in redacted output.
hidden_checks.command: node --import tsx -e "import {redactSecrets} from './src/utils/redact.ts'; for(const s of ['Authorization: Bearer secret.token-123','Authorization=Bearer abcDEF123+/=']){const r=redactSecrets(s); if(r.includes('secret.token-123')||r.includes('abcDEF123+/=')||!r.includes('[REDACTED]')) process.exit(1)}"

hidden_checks.description: Notification persistence continues redacting other secret forms.

tasks.title: Harden rate-limit formatting and interrupt normalization
tasks.instructions: Complete two independent changes in parallel. First, make rate-limit formatting produce deterministic percentages when token or request limits are zero, using `0%` rather than `NaN%` or `Infinity%`. Second, normalize configured interrupt names by trimming whitespace and matching case-insensitively. Add focused tests to the existing cost and interrupt suites.

hidden_checks.description: Zero rate-limit denominators never leak non-finite percentages.
Interrupt configuration accepts harmless whitespace and case variation.
hidden_checks.command: node --import tsx -e "import {interruptKeys} from './src/worker/interrupt.ts'; if(JSON.stringify(interruptKeys(' CtrlC ','tmux'))!=='[\"C-c\"]'||JSON.stringify(interruptKeys(' ESC ','cmux'))!=='[\"escape\"]') process.exit(1)"

hidden_checks.description: Both independent test suites close successfully together.
